prompt_reference.prompt: Titan Gates non-playable campaign character concept art: Mesha Gate-Scribe. Tall ceremonial scribe silhouette in gold-lacquered linen armor, obsidian stylus, sun-disc visor, amber-glowing tablet. Faction/culture: Aten Ra. Visual identity: Gold, bronze, sacred geometry, solar light, obsidian enamel, amber Radiance, pyramid-pylon armor forms.. Role: Lore witness and Codex keeper. Dark tactical mythological fantasy, mobile game character card, painterly detail, full body, strong silhouette, no sci-fi.
prompt_reference.negative_prompt: sci-fi, spaceships, guns, aliens, modern city, superhero costume, photorealistic celebrity, cute cartoon, low detail, blurry, text, watermark, logo

quality_gates: Mobile-readable silhouette at card and battlefield preview scale.
No sci-fi, firearms, spaceships, aliens, modern corporate UI, or generic superhero styling.
Faction identity must remain unmistakable: Aten Ra gold/bronze/sacred geometry/solar law for Titan batch.
Generated image may not be marked imported until a real asset file exists in the artwork pipeline.
Mesha remains non-playable campaign support; art may not imply a playable Hero class.
The First Reopening Gate must read as physical broken Gatefield terrain, not a neon board-game tile set.
